name: W Ibiza
insider_take: Where Balearic beats meet barefoot luxury on Santa Eulalia's pristine shores – this is Ibiza's most electrifying beachfront playground.
whats_special: W Ibiza sits on the exclusive Santa Eulalia Bay, home to the island's only Blue Flag beach. The hotel's signature WET pool deck transforms from serene dayclub to pulsating night scene, while the award-winning SIP rooftop bar offers 360-degree views of the Mediterranean. Unlike Ibiza's party-heavy west coast, this eastern enclave provides sophisticated revelry with world-class DJs spinning against stunning sunrise backdrops.
pro_tip: Book the rooftop SIP bar for sunset cocktails – it's positioned to catch both the golden hour glow and the island's famous full moon parties reflecting off the water.
dont_miss: The hotel's exclusive beach club access to Cala Pada, one of Ibiza's most pristine coves, and the weekly "Wake Up Call" breakfast parties that blur the line between morning ritual and celebration. The nearby Hippy Market at Las Dalias (10 minutes away) offers authentic Ibicenco crafts and that legendary bohemian spirit.
pros: Spectacular beachfront location on Santa Eulalia Bay
World-class beach club and infinity pools with ocean views
Vibrant nightlife scene with renowned DJs and entertainment
Modern suites with private terraces and premium amenities
cons: High-energy party atmosphere may not suit all travelers
